posts.name: PlatinumWarlock
posts.cooked:
I'll be there, running a full slate of my rpg: Cold Steel Wardens: Roleplaying in the Iron Age of Comics.  

I have full (4 hour) sessions every night at 7pm as well at 1pm on Wednesday and Thursday.  I'll also be doing 2 hour demo sessions at 1pm and 3pm on Friday and Saturday.  My wife is running "themed" CSW sessions--based on "Birds of Prey" and "Chew"--at 7pm each night.

You're welcome at any of our games!
